input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: We reviewed the full agreement, including the fees/revenue-share provision (§5, p0023), the licence and definitions (§§2-3, incl. Winning Bid Price at p0014) and the general provisions, and there is no most-favoured-nation, price-matching, best-terms or right-to-match mechanic anywhere. AP is under no obligation to offer Kubient terms no less favourable than those given to any third party; to the contrary, §1 confirms the arrangement is non-exclusive and expressly preserves AP's freedom to offer or sell Inventory through other agents or to third parties. The Winning Bid Price definition operates as a floor in AP's favour (no less than the minimum price AP has agreed to accept), which is a benefit to us and is not flagged. This sits at the playbook preferred position (no Customer MFN obligation), so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
